commits.summary: Initial implementation of AI-powered Gantt chart image extraction using Gemini-2.5-Pro via Lovable AI Gateway.
Added authentication layer (Supabase auth.getUser) and enhanced error handling for rate limits (429) and credit exhaustion (402).

pivots.evidence: While this edge function remained image-based, the surrounding schedule system (src/lib/schedule/import-p6.ts) explicitly deleted XER support in favor of PMXML. This function shifted from being a 'nice-to-have' alternative to the primary path for ad-hoc schedule entry without a formal P6 XML file.

analysis.parser_evolution: The function uses LLM-based extraction (JSON mode via tool_calls) rather than a rigid library parser. The schema (SCHEMA constant) defines the target structure for activities.
analysis.error_handling: Evolved from basic try-catch to specific HTTP status code handling (401 Unauthorized, 402 Credits Exhausted, 429 Rate Limit) to improve client-side UX during AI gateway failures.
